svg.title: 06-tail-example
svg.desc: Conditional analytical example: reciprocal nonnegativeKr proportional tor^(-3-beta),0<beta<2. The second moment converges and fourth moment diverges, giving a nonanalytic |p|^beta approach in the scalar exchange model. This is not a tail or exponent fitted to silicon. The computed silicon fourth moment in the saved finite sampling is finite but large.

g.text: Analytical example: a slowly decaying exchange tail
Finite κ₀ can coexist with a nonquadratic spatial approach.
